pinhole-image-formation.title: Pinhole Image Formation
pinhole-image-formation.text:
​ 针孔成像

Pinhole Camera
​ 针孔摄像机

​ 古人就会使用小孔成像投影了。

Largest Pinhole Photograph
​ 最大的针孔照片

​ 拍摄出的相片将不会有景深。

field-of-view-fov.title: Field of View (FOV)
field-of-view-fov.text:
​ 视野

Effect of Focal Length on FOV
​ 焦距对视野的影响

For a fixed sensor size, decreasing the focal length increases the field of view.
​ 对于固定的传感器尺寸，减小焦距可以增加视野。
\mathrm{FOV}=2\arctan\left(\frac h{2f}\right)

Focal Length v. Field of View
​ 焦距与视野

exposure.title: Exposure
exposure.text:
​ 曝光
H = T\times E
Exposure = time x irradiance
曝光 = 时间 x 辐照度
Exposure time (T)
曝光时间 (T)
Controlled by shutter
由快门控制
Irradiance (E)
辐照度 (E)
Power of light falling on a unit area of sensor
照射到传感器单位面积上的光功率
Controlled by lens aperture and foca

fast-and-slow-photography.title: Fast and Slow Photography
fast-and-slow-photography.text:
​ 高速/低速摄影
High-Speed Photography
Normal exposure = extremely fast shutter speed x (large aperture and/or high ISO)
​ 正常曝光 = 极快的快门速度 x （大光圈和/或高 ISO）

Long-Exposure Photography
​ 快门时间长，导致一段时间内进了一堆光，产生独特的艺术效果（如延时摄影）。

thin-lens-approximation.title: Thin Lens Approximation
thin-lens-approximation.text:
​ 透镜近似

Real Lens Designs Are Highly Complex
​ 真实镜头的结构很复杂。

Real Lens Elements Are Not Ideal – Aberrations
​ 真实镜头元件并不理想——像差

Real plano-convex lens (spherical surface shape).
​ 真正的平凸透镜（球面形状）。
Lens does not converge rays to a point anywhere.
